outcome: Status of the Iranian Maternal Mortality Surveillance System (IMMSS)
cohort: The study involved a review of all related documents and interviews with 15 key informants involved in the Iranian Maternal Mortality Surveillance System.
finding: The Iranian Maternal Mortality Surveillance System (IMMSS) was found to be useful, demonstrating strengths like program implementation and MDG 5 achievement, but also weaknesses such as lack of morbidity information and provincial evaluation.
